summary: Stage 3 reworked against the fifth coverage judge's 9 gaps (rm-coverage-judge-1794477408), each settled from the record: sc_spared lanes isolate the big-corpse body-size rule (mass limit raised) and the corpse mass limit; pit_fall and pit_enemy assert the planned landing cell past the far rim; sc_cover_breaks adds a gas shove onto a cover and a grenade that only reaches a cover (d_q5_cover_breaks 'reaches'); settings sweep checks its list against the settings fields by reflection and names the goods-in-the-air and closed-guard off observables; offline storage and gas census completeness checks and the container scene's mod list; a Bomb-child (BombSuper) lane; the flagship's east colonist expects the wall stop; the sheet adds goods 1.6x and the gas shove's 2 s limit, places per-type strengths in the def patch (dl_modded_strength) and credits the greedy showcase rule.
